name: Spinach-Egg Tacos with Mexican Pickled Veggies (Escabeche) & Avocado

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 jalapeño peppers
3 medium carrots
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ½-inch wide strips. Place in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Cut lengthwise into ½-inch wide strips and add to the bowl with the onion. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds; add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and thinly slice garlic. Transfer to a medium saucepan and set aside.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, jalapeño, carrot, and spices to the pot; cook, stirring often, until veggies are crisp-tender, 3-5 minutes. Return veggies to the bowl, reserving the pot for later use.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, add vinegar, water, sugar, and salt to the saucepan with the garlic; stir to combine. Bring the pickling liquid to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup red wine vinegar
¾ cup water
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Pour the pickling liquid into the bowl over the cooked veggies. Stir to combine and set aside to cool.
Coarsely grate cheese and place in a large bowl. Add eggs and spices, then whisk until combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (227 g) block mozzarella cheese
15 eggs
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop the spinach leaves and add to the bowl with the egg; stir to combine.
Wipe the pot clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Pour egg mixture into the pot; scramble the eggs using a combination of stirring and folding, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until eggs are no longer runny, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the eggs are cooking, warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional), 15-30 seconds.
Halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates and fill with spinach-scrambled eggs. Top with pickled veggies and avocado. Enjoy!
